section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participants and design of a single study. It involved 47 participants (23 male, 24 female) with a mean age of 29.26, recruited via Craigslist.com. Participants were fluent in English, right-handed, had no history of brain damage, and received $90 for their involvement in the study, which was approved by the local Institutional Review Board.
